name: Levi-Civita connection
domain: smooth Riemannian manifold (M,g); implemented locally on a declared nondegenerate coordinate chart
definition: The unique affine connection on TM that is metric compatible and torsion free.
coordinate_form: Gamma^k_ij = 1/2 g^{k ell}(partial_i g_{j ell}+partial_j g_{i ell}-partial_ell g_{ij})
hypotheses: g is a smooth Riemannian metric
regularity: smooth metric for theorem; symbolic implementation assumes differentiable metric entries on the declared chart
counterexamples: Christoffel symbols can be nonzero in polar coordinates on intrinsically flat Euclidean space
limitations: curvature sign convention is explicit and may differ from other sources
